items.source: Return true if objects of sourceType can be converted to the targetType.

items.source: Recursively unwraps well known wrapper types from the given TypeInformation.
items.translation: 递归地解包给定的TypeInformation中已知的包装类型。

items.source: Maps elements of a reactive element stream to other elements.
items.translation: 将响应式元素流中的元素映射到其他元素。

items.source: Returns whether the given type is supported for wrapper type conversion.
items.translation: 返回给定的类型是否支持包装器类型转换。

items.source: Casts or adopts the given wrapper type to a target wrapper type.
items.translation: 将给定的包装器类型转换为目标包装器类型。

items.source: NOTE: A reactive wrapper type might be supported in general by ReactiveWrappers.supports(Class) but not necessarily for conversion using this method.
items.translation: 注意：虽然 `ReactiveWrappers.supports(Class)` 方法可能普遍支持反应式包装类型，但这并不一定意味着可以通过此方法进行转换。

items.source:
This class discovers reactive wrapper availability and their conversion support based on the class path. Reactive
wrapper types might be supported/on the class path but conversion may require additional dependencies.
items.translation: 该类会根据类路径发现响应式包装器的可用性及其转换支持。尽管响应式包装器类型可能在类路径上可用，但转换可能需要额外的依赖项。
